x: One of the biggest break-throughs of the Championships came from the purple-haired Philips Idowu who triple jumped 16.87 to beat rival Larry Achike and once again break the Olympic Qualifying standard.

Two days later a 16.97 leap gave Phillips the 5th best performance in the opening round of the final with the two other Britons ahead of him - Larry Achike leading at 17.29 and Jonathon Edwards 4th with 17.12.
